defs.def: a sum of money that you pay regularly to your employer or the government in order to pay for benefits such as health insurance, a pension, etc. （给雇主或政府用作医疗保险、养老金等津贴的）定期缴款

defs.def: an action or a service that helps to cause or increase sth 贡献；促成作用
